razonamiento: Indigo Carbon collects satellite data from providers like NASA and processes it to generate carbon credits and serve imagery to farmers. The architecture consists of an ingestion pipeline (Satellites -> EC2 Spot -> S3 and RDS), an interactive user map-tile serving workflow (User <-> AWS Fargate <-> ElastiCache, RDS, and S3), and an on-demand time-series analytics pipeline (User -> Lambda -> RDS, S3).
nombre: Indigo Carbon Satellite Imagery Processing Architecture
